name: Mimi
source:
Brought up in the countryside, an innocent and pure wolf girl.
Her smile is lovely and does not discriminate among anyone.
Different from the air-headed angel Noel, a cute and bright girl.

"Amu.. You know, Mimi.. Mimi! When praised by Onii-chan, I feel somewhat fluffy!"
